answer: Sybil resistance follows because reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, requiring sustained honest service to retain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has negligible incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed credibility, preventing it from crossing consensus thresholds. A lagoon of isolated accounts cannot bridge that gap, even if each whispers endorsements to the others.
